verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a marketplace or listing catalog of third-party datasets. Secure Data Sharing (sharing objects between Snowflake accounts without copying), Data Clean Rooms, and the Native App Framework (distributing data applications) are related mechanisms, not a documented marketplace for discovering and using third-party datasets, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an analyst, a marketplace of third-party datasets lets me enrich my own data directly inside the platform
